title: Secondary Physics — Current in a Simple Circuit
subject: physics
disclaimer: Ideal ohmic resistor with negligible internal resistance and no heating-dependent resistance change.

beats.label: Predict
beats.narration: Predict what happens to current when resistance doubles at fixed voltage.

beats.label: Observe
beats.narration: Observe how current changes when voltage or resistance varies.

beats.label: Explain
beats.narration: Ohm's law applies to an ohmic conductor at constant temperature: I = V / R.

check.question: At fixed voltage, what happens if resistance doubles?
check.explanation: Since I = V/R, doubling resistance halves current for an ohmic resistor.
